content.title: A Gift of 10 Million Expressions of Love Toward Madinah: Will You Be Part of It?
content.subtitle: Coming very soon to Muslims Day: 10 Million Durood Challenge!
content.body:
Imagine that moment of supreme fortune—on the fierce, scorching plains of Qiyamah, when a luminous platter filled with millions of Durood is presented before our beloved Prophet ﷺ, and nestled within that platter is your and my tearful gift of love! On that Day, what greater blessing could an Ummah ask for?

Individually, many of us recite Durood upon our beloved Prophet ﷺ every day. But imagine if millions of believers worldwide united in a single voice of love to send an unprecedented offering of 10 million Durood toward Madinah. To awaken that tide of prophetic devotion in every heart, the Muslims Day family is introducing a historic initiative for the very first time: "10 Million Durood Challenge."

A Unique Caravan of Love Across Millions of Believers

This initiative is our shared platform to express pure, unyielding love for our beloved Prophet ﷺ. Through a dedicated web link with a clean and user-friendly interface, we will all come together to fulfill this milestone of ten million Durood, Insha’Allah. From the comfort of your home and at your convenience, you can recite Durood on screen and contribute directly to this blessed live-counter endeavor.

A Golden Opportunity to Build Your Akhirah Amid a Busy Life

Amid the intense rush of day and night, let us join this sacred journey ourselves and share it with family, friends, and loved ones. A single share from you might touch hundreds of weary hearts with love for the Prophet ﷺ. By contributing your share to this massive voyage of ten million Durood, let us illuminate our Dunya and Akhirah, filling our hearts with the timeless fragrance of prophetic love.

Get Ready to Be Part of History

Insha’Allah, this noble endeavor will commence very soon. Keep an eye on Muslims Day and keep your heart and tongue ready—let us all join this procession of love toward Madinah, Insha’Allah.
